step1_figure.circuit_type: Delta-Sigma Modulator (DSM) Sensing Circuit for CMOS Image Sensor Column Readout
step1_figure.description: Figure 17.33 shows the complete delta-sigma sensing circuit for CMOS image sensor column readout. It converts the analog reference voltage (VR) and intensity voltage (VI) into currents using PMOS source followers, uses switched-capacitor resistors to scale the currents, sums them onto a bucket capacitor, and uses a clocked comparator with feedback (Out) to modulate the charge integration and produce a digital bitstream.

max_column_voltage.description: Maximum allowable column voltage compliance to keep PMOS voltage-to-current converters operational

equation.explanation: To ensure that the PMOS V-to-I converter transistor remains turned on and acts as a source follower with VSG ≈ |VTHP|, the column voltage must stay below VDD - |VTHP|.
equation.assumptions: PMOS device is in its own n-well with source connected to the switched-capacitor network.

sky130_expected.reasoning: With VDD = 1.8 V in SKY130 and PMOS threshold |VTHP| of ~0.42 V, the input voltage must remain below 1.38 V.

vr_shift.description: Shifted reference voltage driving the reference branch switched-capacitor resistor

equation.explanation: Represents the effective voltage dropped across the switched-capacitor resistor in the reference branch after accounting for the PMOS gate-to-source drop.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Nominal reference level is 650 mV; with VDD = 1.8 V and |VTHP| = 0.42 V, the shifted reference voltage is 0.73 V.

vi_shift.description: Shifted light intensity voltage driving the intensity branch switched-capacitor resistor

equation.explanation: Effective voltage across the intensity branch switched-capacitor resistor, proportional to the sampled illumination level.

sky130_expected.reasoning: At an intensity level of 400 mV, the shifted voltage across the switched-capacitor branch is 0.98 V.

switched_cap_resistance.description: Equivalent resistance of the reference switched-capacitor branch

equation.explanation: The effective resistance formed by the switched-capacitor cup capacitor Ccup operating at switching frequency f_clk.
equation.assumptions: Complete charge transfer during each non-overlapping clock phase.

sky130_expected.calculation: Ccup = 100 fF = 1e-13 F. Clock period T = 10 ns (f_clk = 100 MHz). RR = 1 / (100e6 * 100e-15) = 100 kΩ.
sky130_expected.reasoning: At 100 MHz clock frequency with 100 fF cup capacitors, the equivalent resistance is 100 kΩ.

ref_branch_current.description: Average current flowing through the reference branch into the diode-connected mirror

equation.explanation: Average reference current integrated into the diode-connected load, mirrored to discharge the bucket capacitor.
equation.assumptions: Steady-state switching operation over many clock periods.

sky130_expected.calculation: VR,shift = 0.73 V, RR = 100 kΩ. IR = 0.73 V / 100 kΩ = 7.3 µA.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Driven by shifted reference voltage 0.73 V across 100 kΩ switched-capacitor resistance.

modulator_pulse_density.description: Delta-sigma modulator average output pulse density (fraction of clock cycles where Out is high)

equation.explanation: In steady-state DSM balance, charge injected by the intensity path equals charge subtracted by the reference path. Since the intensity path is gated by Out_bar = (N-M)/N, VI,shift * (N-M)/N = VR,shift, yielding M/N = 1 - VR,shift/VI,shift.
equation.assumptions: Modulator in stable limit-cycle oscillation without integrator saturation.

sky130_expected.reasoning: For VI = 400 mV and VR = 650 mV, the output duty cycle is nominally 25.5%.

sensed_intensity_voltage.description: Digitally reconstructed shifted light intensity voltage from modulator count M

equation.explanation: Calculates the reconstructed light intensity voltage from the reference voltage and digital counter value M over N conversion cycles.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Should reconstruct the applied shifted intensity voltage within quantization error.

base_sensing_resolution.description: Quantization voltage resolution of the DSM sensing system for N conversion cycles

equation.explanation: Base step size / resolution of the delta-sigma sensor when operating over N clock periods.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Over 100 clock cycles with VR,shift = 730 mV, one LSB is approximately 7.3 mV.

hold_cap_thermal_noise.description: RMS thermal noise sampled onto the column hold capacitor CH

equation.explanation: kT/C sampled thermal noise across hold capacitor CH = 1 pF.

sky130_expected.calculation: sqrt(1.38e-23 * 300 / 1e-12) = 64.3 µV RMS. Peak-to-peak (6 * RMS) ≈ 386 µV.
sky130_expected.reasoning: With 1 pF hold capacitor at room temperature, kT/C noise is 64.3 µV RMS.

step3_testbench.description: Transient testbench for the DSM imager column readout circuit. Generates sampling control pulses (shr, shi), non-overlapping switched-capacitor clock phases (phi1, phi2), and the clocked comparator evaluation strobe (clock). Measures sampled reference and intensity voltages, average bucket and mirror node voltages, and the modulator pulse density (duty cycle).
